posts.trend: Indian Office Leasing Shifts to Connectivity and Air Quality
posts.context: Corporates are using state-of-the-art building specifications to pressure remote workers back into physical commutes.
posts.angle: Your employer is offering you basic survival standards as an office perk.
slides: Your HR has a new reason for you to come back to the desk.

In 2021: "Work from anywhere. Your peace of mind is our priority."
In 2023: "In-person collaboration creates corporate synergy."
In 2026: "Our office air has a PM2.5 rating of under 10."

You commute through a toxic grey cloud for two hours.

To breathe their air.
posts.caption: Return to office because the oxygen is company property. 💨 #corporate #delhipollution #rto
posts.rank_verdict: The turn to air quality as a corporate retention metric is brilliant, but projecting it to 2026 delays the horror of a reality that is already here.
